summary: Challenging logic puzzles. Can you solve them all?
description:
Trees and Tents is a challenging logic puzzle. Place a tent next to each tree on the grid, but make sure that the tents do not touch, even diagonally! The numbers on the sides indicate how many tents there are in each row or column. Each puzzle has exactly one solution, which can be found through logic reasoning. No guessing is needed!

While solving these logic puzzles can be tough, you can always check if your solution is correct so far and ask for a hint if you get stuck.

Solve these logic puzzles to challenge yourself, relax, exercise your brain, or simply pass the time. These puzzles offer hours of engaging entertainment! With difficulties ranging from easy to expert, there's something for puzzle enthusiasts of every skill level.

Are you up for the challenge? Can you solve them all?

Features:
- Check if your solution is correct so far
- Ask for hints (unlimited and with explanation)
- Works offline
- Dark mode and multiple color themes
- And much more...

All puzzles in this app are created by brennerd.
